verdict.rationale: Steel's own integration guides document typed, structured extraction: the AI SDK integration tools "extract, return typed results" [steel-docs-39], the Pydantic AI and OpenAI Agents SDK guides build typed browser agents that extract data [steel-docs-41, steel-docs-42], and the Pi extension can "extract structured data" [steel-docs-44]. The schema typing and validation appear to come from those third-party frameworks rather than a native Steel extraction API. Steel's own browser tools only document markdown, readability, screenshot and PDF conversion [steel-gh-3]. missing for 10: a native Steel schema-validated extraction endpoint (Zod/Pydantic schema in, validated JSON out), detailed docs on validation and error handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
